column1: # The jars of Whelk 1.2.1's OWL API binding and their runtime dependencies, which Maven
# resolved for org.geneontology:whelk-owlapi_2.13:1.2.1 (OWL API 4.5.22 and Scala 2.13.14),
# with slf4j-simple 1.7.36 to print warnings. The aggregate owlapi-distribution jar is left
# out, since its modules are listed one by one. nix/reasoners/default.nix fetches each from
# Maven Central under this path and checks it against its SHA-256 here, which was checked
# against Maven Central's SHA-1 when it was pinned. Whelk is licensed under BSD-3-Clause,
# Scala under Apache-2.0 and the OWL API under LGPL-3.0 or Apache-2.0.
